item.title: Vela 1.0-beta.2
item.description:
A beta build with the newest changes.

  • Turn on self-updates with the public update key
  • Fix package script stopping after the build on GitHub
  • Add an update pipeline: PR build checks, beta and stable releases, self-updates
  • Fix school and work sign-in loops with sign-in cookie exceptions
  • Add Reader mode, live Safari bookmarks, default-browser support and packaging
  • Add image and video search grids from DuckDuckGo, with animation polish
  • Add the Spotify mini player along the bottom of the window
  • Add Claude: address bar quick answers and a side panel that can use your tabs
  • Add optional Google Safe Browsing checks for pages and downloads
  • Fix "Sign in with Google": keep pop-up windows linked to their opener
  • Add passwords, link checker, safe downloads, script slider, stronger ad blocking and themes
  • Add privacy shield: ad/tracker blocking, pop-up blocker, cookie manager
  • Add Safari-style features, richer tab menu, bookmarks sidebar and app icon
  • Add core Vela browser: tabs, tab groups, address bar, bookmarks
  • Initial commit
